description: This file defines the httpCache class, which provides methods for HTTP caching, including caching files and content, checking modification times, and setting appropriate headers.

classes.name: httpCache
classes.description: Helper class for managing HTTP cache headers and content delivery.

methods.name: file
methods.description: Caches a file by setting appropriate HTTP headers based on file's MIME type and modification time.

methods.name: content
methods.description: Caches given content with specified modification time, MIME type, and expiration, and outputs it with headers.

methods.name: checkMTime
methods.description: Checks if the client's cached version is up-to-date based on modification time and sends 304 status if so.
